verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs say components can be reused across files, and that updates to a main component propagate to its linked copies. This covers the core of cross-file reuse with source-driven updates. There is no evidence of an explicit shared-library publishing flow, of styles or tokens being shared across projects, or of controlled review and acceptance of updates. Community comments that design-system features lag Figma and that components are hard to handle are general, not concrete contradictions. Missing for 10: an explicit library publish/share mechanism, cross-project style sharing, a controlled update review/accept flow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
